title: ViDoRe V3: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation in Complex Real-World Scenarios
reasoning: The paper presents a benchmark for evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems across multimodal document corpora. While it includes a standard section on 'Ethical considerations' discussing annotator welfare and data licensing, it does not involve the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
